passages.text: Please read the following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations together with our Consolidated Financial Statements and related Notes thereto included under Item 15 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. OVERVIEW Gen Digital Inc. is a global leader in consumer Cyber Safety and Trust-Based Solutions, empowering people around the world to live safer digital lives while building confidence and control over their financial futures. Through its trusted brands, including Norton, Avast, LifeLock and MoneyLion, Gen offers cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to consumers worldwide. Our Cyber Safety Platform includes our security, comprehensive suites, and privacy products, which deliver technology solutions and superior threat protection to help people navigate the digital world securely, privately and with confidence. Our Trust-Based Solutions includes our identity protection, restoration support services, digital reputation, and secure financial wellness, including our first-party MoneyLion products and our Engine marketplace offerings. Fiscal calendar We have a 52/53-week fiscal year ending on the Friday closest to March 31. Fiscal 2026, 2025 and 2024 in this report refers to fiscal years ended April 3, 2026, March 28, 2025 and March 29, 2024, respectively. Fiscal 2026 consisted of 53 weeks, whereas fiscal years 2025 and 2024 each consisted of 52 weeks. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: A description of the risk factors associated with our business is set forth below and in “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations,” “Legal Proceedings,” “Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk” and “Controls and Procedures.” The list is not exhaustive, and you should carefully consider these risks and uncertainties before investing in our common stock. RISKS RELATED TO OUR BUSINESS STRATEGY AND INDUSTRY If we are unable to develop new and enhanced solutions and products, or continually improve the performance, features, and reliability of our existing solutions and products, our business and operating results could be adversely affected. Our future success depends on our ability to effectively respond to evolving consumer threats, technological advancements, competitive developments and industry changes, by developing or introducing new and enhanced solutions and products on a timely basis. We have incurred, and will continue to incur, significant research and development expenses, including investments in AI, to drive organic growth and reduce reliance on third-party technologies. If these investments do not produce the anticipated benefits, or if such benefits are delayed, our operating results could be adversely affected. We must continually address the challenges of dynamic and accelerating market trends and competitive developments. The development and integration of new technologies — including generative AI (“Gen AI”) and machine learning — is complex, time-consuming, and subject to significant risks. New technologies may contain errors, vulnerabilities, or unintended outputs, including incorrect or biased results, that are not easily detectable, which could lead to customer dissatisfaction, reputational harm, litigation, or increased regulatory scrutiny. Customers may also demand features or capabilities that our current solutions do not offer, and failure to innovate in a timely and cost-effective manner could impair our ability to retain existing customers and attract new customers. The development and introduction of new solutions involve significant commitments of time and resources and are subject to risks and challenges including but not limited to: • Lengthy development cycles; • Evolving industry and regulatory standards and technological developments, including AI and machine learning, by our competitors and customers; • Rapidly changing customer preferences and accurately anticipating technological trends or needs; • Evolving platforms, operating systems, and hardware products, such as mobile devices; • Product and service interoperability challenges with customer’s technology and third-party vendors; • The integration of products and solutions from acquired companies; 12 Table of Contents • Availability of engineering and technical talent; • Entering new or unproven market segments; • New and evolving regulation; and • Executing new product and service strategies. credit_strengths.text: Operating margin is well above the sector median and improved year over year, reflecting the high-margin subscription mix across Norton, Avast and the acquired MoneyLion financial wellness offerings. This pricing power underpins stable recurring cash generation through the consumer cyber safety cycle.

Free cash flow comfortably covers dividends and buybacks combined, with operating cash flow also exceeding total shareholder distributions. Internal cash generation therefore funds the capital return programme without incremental borrowing, a meaningful support for creditor positioning.

key_risks.text: Gross and net leverage sit well above the sector median, and the indicative risk profile is Aggressive on the weaker cash-flow measure. Headroom to the next leverage band boundary is thin, so modest EBITDA erosion or incremental debt-funded acquisitions could tip the profile lower.

The debt note shows large term loan and senior note maturities clustering in the middle years of the profile, including the extended term facility and the later-dated notes. Refinancing depends on continued credit access, and the revolving facility provides only partial backup.

Risk factors flag heavy and continuing research and development spending, including generative AI investment, where delayed or unrealised benefits would pressure operating results. Integration of acquired businesses such as MoneyLion adds execution risk to an already leveraged balance sheet.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage improved year over year and remains comfortably above unity, but sits far below the sector median, consistent with the Aggressive cash-flow tier. Debt service is manageable at current operating income, though the cushion against a earnings downturn is narrower than peers.

Cash flow to debt improved year over year yet remains below the sector median, and the current ratio is far under one and below peers, reflecting a liability-heavy working capital profile. Liquidity relies on recurring subscription collections rather than balance-sheet buffers.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer combines a high-margin, cash-generative consumer software franchise with leverage above sector norms and an Aggressive indicative risk profile. Deleveraging year over year and strong free cash flow coverage of distributions are offsets, but the thin threshold headroom leaves limited tolerance for shocks.

Our forward view is that credit quality stabilises if operating income growth continues and acquisitions are funded from free cash flow rather than new borrowings. Continued buybacks absorb a large share of cash generation, so we would monitor distribution policy and the maturity profile as the key swing factors.

credit_strengths.text: 營運利潤率遠高於行業中位數，並較去年同期改善，反映Norton、Avast及所收購MoneyLion財務健康產品組合的高利潤率訂閱業務結構。此定價能力支撐消費網絡安全週期下穩定的經常性現金產生。
自由現金流足以覆蓋股息與回購的總和，營運現金流亦超過股東分派總額。因此，內部現金產生可在不增加借貸的情況下為資本回報計劃提供資金，對債權人定位構成重要支持。

key_risks.text: 總槓桿及淨槓桿遠高於行業中位數，而按較弱的現金流指標計算，指示性風險狀況為進取型。距下一槓桿區間界限的緩衝空間有限，因此溫和的EBITDA侵蝕或增量債務融資收購可能使該狀況進一步下調。
債務附註顯示大額定期貸款及優先票據到期集中於該狀況的中段年份，包括經延長的定期融資及較後到期的票據。再融資取決於持續的信贷准入，而循環融資僅提供部分備份。
風險因素指出研發支出龐大且持續，包括生成式人工智能投資，若相關效益延遲或未能實現，將對營運業績構成壓力。整合MoneyLion等所收購業務，為已然槓桿化的資產負債表增添執行風險。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率較去年同期改善，並仍遠高於一，但遠低於行業中位數，與進取型現金流級別一致。按當前營運收入計算，償債能力可控，惟抵禦盈利下滑的緩衝較同業為窄。
現金流對債務比率較去年同期改善，但仍低於行業中位數，而流動比率遠低於一且低於同業，反映負債偏重的營運資金結構。流動性依賴經常性訂閱收款，而非資產負債表緩衝。

overall_credit_view.text: 該發行人兼具高利潤率、現金產生能力強的消費軟件特許經營權，以及高於行業常規的槓桿及進取型指示性風險狀況。同比去槓桿及自由現金流對分派的強勁覆蓋為抵銷因素，但薄弱的門檻緩衝空間對衝擊的容忍度有限。
我們的前瞻觀點是，若營運收入增長持續，且收購以自由現金流而非新增借貸提供資金，信貸質量將趨於穩定。持續回購吸收現金產生的很大份額，因此我們將監察分派政策及到期結構作為主要擺動因素。
